name: genai-adoption-lingarian-citizenapp-fullstack-template
description: LingarIAn Full-Stack Template with AI adoption features

scripts.podman:up: PLATFORM=$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/linux\/amd64/; s/arm64/linux\/arm64/; s/aarch64/linux\/arm64/') podman compose -f podman-compose.yml up --build
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:dependencies:up && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.dev:dependencies:reset: podman compose -f podman-compose.dev.yml down -v && echo 'Database reset complete - all data removed!'
scripts.build:check: npm run build && npm run test:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:backend && npm run lint:fix:frontend
scripts.lint:fix:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.clean: rimraf frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/.venv && echo 'Cleanup complete!'

author: Lingaro
